answer: Yes, an open safety recall won't stop us from buying your car, and it doesn't change your offer; you can have the free recall repair done at a dealer for your car's brand first if you like, but you don't have to. If the hailstorm left damage, list it on the damage disclosure form NW-DMG-1 before the inspection, since disclosed damage is already priced into your offer and won't lower it again. The help center doesn't cover selling a car with an open insurance claim, so please contact a store about that part.
